_note: Recall values are measured (hardware-independent) so the recall guard is active. Latency values are zero and 'latency_guard: unarmed' marks this file as the explicit placeholder: the latency regression test skips (loudly) instead of failing every trusted run. To arm the latency guard, run the Benchmark workflow on a trusted ref, download the benchmark-results-<sha> artifact, and commit it as this file — artifacts carry no latency_guard flag, so committing one arms the guard automatically. A zero p95 WITHOUT the unarmed flag fails the run as a misconfigured baseline. Latency baselines must come from CI runners; numbers from other hardware are not comparable.
